title: Assertion: Start Precedes Done
constraints: Rule: `done` may only be high if `start` was high in one of the **previous 10 cycles** (not the same cycle).
Looking backwards is awkward in pure SVA. Auxiliary modeling code (a counter) inside the checker is allowed and is common practice.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Keep a counter `since_start`: reset it when start is seen, otherwise count up (saturating).
Then assert `done |-> since_start inside {[1:10]}` (0 = start seen this cycle, not allowed).
Update the counter with nonblocking assignments in `always @(posedge clk)`, so the assertion sees the pre-edge value.
